project_type: AssetRipper reconstruction of Beijing/Subway Surfers 1.94.0 assets and scenes; not the original Unity source project
removed_reference_folder_contents: Prior AssetRipper export copy and TexLow PNGs; active Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings and Beijing analysis reports are preserved.
wasm2c_limitation: Installed wasm2c reported only a generic limited-feature-set error; it did not identify a specific unsupported opcode.
last_cloud_build_failure_cause: Three AssetRipper-generated dummy C# scripts had illegal identifiers/namespace syntax.
notes: The Unity project folders at repository root were replaced with the AssetRipper export; the previously generated Beijing Runner prototype WebGL archive is not a build of this active project.
ProjectVersion.txt is set to Unity 2022.3.62f3. The submitted Cloud Build log confirms batch-mode import/processing with that Editor, but the build failed during script compilation.
AssetRipper exported 1,864 objects into scenes, prefabs, meshes, animations, textures, materials, audio and other assets; recovered scripts are stubs rather than original method logic.
Cpp2IL IL Recovery DLLs were decompiled with ILSpy into reference-only C# sources. The output is approximate, includes many unresolved decompiler markers, and is not imported under Assets.
The assistant did not run a compilation. The user's submitted Cloud Build attempt did compile scripts but failed before producing a WebGL build; post-fix status remains unverified.

The raw UnityWeb inputs and the identical extracted WASM module were removed from the current tree and local working copies; older Git commits still retain the blobs because history was not rewritten.

Recovered_Assets_Reference, containing a redundant older AssetRipper export copy and TexLow textures, was removed from the current tree at the user's request; the active Unity project folders were not removed.
The existing WABT structured pseudocode was regenerated with WABT 1.0.34 --enable-all and matched byte-for-byte; a named WAT output was also created and compressed.
WABT wasm2c was attempted but reported a generic limited-feature-set error without naming a specific unsupported feature; see BUILD_REPORT.txt.

The submitted Cloud Build log confirmed Unity 2022.3.62f3 and reported C# syntax errors in three unreferenced AssetRipper dummy scripts. A static scan found 12 more invalid type identifiers in unreferenced dummy stubs; all 15 files and their .meta files were removed. No post-fix build was run.
